title: Learning to Reason in Real-Time
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.33513v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI agents that operate in the real world must reason correctly and on-time, yet they currently do not account for how time should alter their reasoning. Modern agents learn to do tasks in environments that are entirely synchronous: where the world waits for the agent to act before changing. A real-time environment, by contrast, changes independent of the agent. Existing approaches try to bridge this gap by imposing a ratio of thinking to acting. However, for an agent to succeed in real-time it must learn to act quickly when delay is costly and to reason longer when the benefit outweighs the missed opportunities. To this end, we introduce real-time reasoning training (RRT) as the class of training techniques for real-time reasoning agents. We develop three standard RRT techniques: (1) using real-time data, (2) decoupling acting and observing, and (3) curriculum learning in time. reason_zh: 首次系统提出实时环境下智能体推理的时间感知问题，对具身与在线agent设计有启发。
summary_zh: 论文指出当前AI智能体都在完全同步的环境中学习任务，即世界会等待智能体行动后才变化，因此它们从未学会考虑时间应如何改变推理过程。而真实世界环境是异步变化的，会在智能体思考期间独立演进。作者提出智能体需要在实时环境中正确且及时地推理，并围绕这一设定构建问题框架与训练方法，探讨如何让模型在有限时间预算下权衡推理深度与响应时效，为实时部署的agent提供新的研究范式。
title_zh: 学习在实时环境中推理

title: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
raw_text:
Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%.

The post Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache appeared first on MarkTechPost.
reason_zh: 复用目标模型稀疏 KV cache 的投机解码方案，不增显存且 64K 吞吐提升最高 81%，工程价值明确。
summary_zh: 腾讯开源 DFly2，一种面向稀疏注意力大模型的投机解码草稿模型方案。其核心设计是每一层草稿层都复用目标模型的 KV cache 与 top-k indexer 选择结果，因此不额外占用草稿 KV 显存。官方数据显示，在 64K 长上下文服务场景下吞吐最高提升 81%。该方案针对稀疏注意力架构做了专门适配，对长上下文推理部署的工程优化有直接参考价值。
title_zh: 腾讯开源 DFly2：复用目标模型稀疏 KV cache 的投机解码

title: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
raw_text:
More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion record console launch. AI coding agents like Claude Code are speeding up the process so much that an early unofficial multiplayer mode is already running. Rockstar's delayed PC business model is coming under pressure.

The article Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents? appeared first on The Decoder.
reason_zh: 以GTA 6泄露移植为切口，讨论AI编码代理对游戏发行模式的冲击。
summary_zh: 文章以GTA 6泄露的Xbox版本为背景，指出在主机版创下37.9亿美元首发纪录后仅数日，已有40多个项目通过逆向工程将该作移植到PC。作者由此提出Rockstar面临的AI困境：编码代理大幅降低了逆向工程与移植的门槛，使得传统的分阶段发行模式（先主机后PC）越来越难以维持，独占协议与DMCA下架等手段的效果正在被AI工具削弱。
title_zh: Rockstar的AI困境：GTA 6的分阶段发行模式能否在编码代理时代存活？

summary_zh: 蚂蚁百灵发布并开源新一代大模型 Ling-3.2-air，总参数 1240 亿，每个 token 仅激活 55 亿，稀疏度约 4.4%，推理成本对标 5.5B 小模型。模型卡披露了较完整的架构细节，属于 Hybrid-linear MoE，共 35 层并采用 KDA 结构。官方称其在编程、智能体与多模态能力上有所提升。该稀疏比例在同类 MoE 模型中较为激进，对研究低成本推理部署有参考意义。

title: 微信开源 WeMM-Ecom：多模态基础模型家族、基于真实电商需求驱动

reason_zh: 微信开源面向电商场景的多模态模型家族，针对SKU细粒度识别痛点，值得电商与多模态从业者关注。
summary_zh: 腾讯微信视觉团队开源多模态基础模型家族 WeMM-Ecom，代码托管于 GitHub 的 Tencent/WeMM-Ecom，权重同步上线 Hugging Face。该模型针对真实电商需求设计，解决通用多模态模型难以区分的细粒度商品问题，例如 500g 单袋咖啡豆与两袋 250g 组合装外观相似、总重相同但属于不同 SKU。公告强调让通用大模型真正“看懂商品”，面向电商场景的识别与理解任务。
title_zh: 微信开源 WeMM-Ecom：多模态基础模型家族、基于真实电商需求驱动

title: Show HN: Open-Sourced Code Mode to Cut ~60% of My Rust Agent's Token Burn

For those who are tracking, Anthropic released an announcement last week about their experimental code mode for Claude Code, claiming some bonkers token savings when it comes to tool calls (95% on some workloads(1)). title: Faster and Better Query (FBQ): Learning Future-Position Probes from the First Generated Token
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.33679v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When a large language model (LLM) evicts prompt keys and values at the end of prefill, it must decide what to keep before it sees the queries from subsequent decoding steps. Generating a draft continuation can approximate those queries at the cost of extra autoregressive steps. Can we use the embedding of the first output token, already available from the final prefill logits, to construct low-cost pseudo queries that approximate future decoding queries? We start with FTQ-8, which places eight copies of the first token ID at consecutive future positions and reads their attention to the prompt in one causal forward pass. Each copy sees a different prefix, but a generic opening such as the offers a poor literal guess for seven successive tokens. reason_zh: 利用首个生成token的嵌入预测未来查询，改进KV缓存淘汰效率。
summary_zh: 论文研究大模型在预填充阶段结束时淘汰提示词键值缓存的问题：模型必须在看到后续解码步骤的查询之前决定保留哪些内容。生成草稿续写可近似这些查询，但需额外自回归步骤。作者提出FBQ方法，直接利用首个输出token的嵌入来预测未来位置查询，从而在无需额外解码的情况下更准确地估计哪些KV应被保留。该方法在提升缓存淘汰效果的同时降低了开销。
title_zh: 更快更好的查询（FBQ）：从首个生成token学习未来位置探针

title: Anthropic 放出 Claude Ship：内部 PR 合并量 3 个月翻倍，回滚比例下降超 40%

reason_zh: Anthropic内部工具Claude Ship提升PR合并效率，对工程团队有参考价值。
summary_zh: Anthropic推出内部工具Claude Ship，用于辅助代码审查与合并流程。据雷锋网报道，该工具上线后三个月内，内部PR合并量翻倍，回滚比例下降超过40%。Claude Ship利用Claude模型自动分析代码变更、生成审查意见并预测合并风险，从而减少人工审查负担和错误合并。文章介绍了该工具的基本功能与量化效果，但未深入技术实现细节。
